sents.zh: 北京有一个很大很老的地方，叫故宫。
sents.en: In Beijing there is a very large, very old place called the Forbidden City.

sents.zh: 它是六百多年以前明朝的皇帝让人做的。
sents.en: It was built for a Ming emperor more than six hundred years ago.

sents.zh: 做这个地方用了十几年。
sents.en: Building it took more than ten years.
Inside are more than nine thousand rooms.

sents.zh: 如果每天住一个房间，要住二十多年。
sents.en: If you slept in one room a night, it would take over twenty years.
The outer gates are high and great.
The buildings are red, and very beautiful.

sents.zh: 皇帝在最大的那个房间里做事。
sents.en: The emperor worked in the largest hall.

sents.zh: 每天早上，很多官来见他。
sents.en: Every morning many officials came to see him.

sents.zh: 他们进来的时候，一句话也不敢多说。
sents.en: As they came in they dared not say a word more than needed.

sents.zh: 因为这里要做的事情非常多。
sents.en: Because there was so much here that had to be done just so.

sents.zh: 里面还放着很多好看的东西。
sents.en: Many beautiful things were kept inside.

sents.zh: 有字，有书，还有金子做的东西。
sents.en: There is writing, there are books, and things made of gold.

sents.zh: 以前，一般人不可以进去。
sents.en: In the past ordinary people could not go in.

sents.zh: 可是今天，每个人都可以进去看一看。
sents.en: But today anyone may go in and look.
